_comment: broca-machina FILE-transport example — for hosts that run their own event loop. broca-machina writes each transcript to transcriptDir/<timestamp>.txt and speaks whatever text appears in replyFile (then deletes it). Your side watches transcriptDir and writes replies to replyFile. Run file_brain.sh as a reference host loop, or wire your own. Replace every /ABS/PATH/TO/... with real absolute paths, set discord.allowedUserId to YOUR Discord user ID, and fill in the guild/channel IDs. See README.md.
